content.short: SafePal is a Binance-backed hardware and software crypto wallet supporting Mantle and 100+ blockchains with built-in DeFi and NFT tools.
content.description: SafePal is a comprehensive crypto asset management platform backed by Binance Labs, offering both hardware wallets and software wallet solutions. The hardware wallet provides air-gapped offline key storage for maximum security, while the SafePal App offers a mobile-first interface with built-in DEX swaps, cross-chain bridging, staking, and DApp browser. SafePal supports Mantle Network alongside over 100 blockchains, making it one of the most versatile wallets available for Mantle users who value both security and DeFi functionality.
content.meta: SafePal is a Binance-backed hardware and software wallet supporting Mantle and 100+ blockchains. Discover SafePal on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
